title: Mark Zuckerberg Posts Deranged 6,500-Word Essay About Giving Everyone AI Superintelligence
content:
Mark Zuckerberg, whose superyacht apparently spent the weekend ignoring or missing the distress signal from a boat that ran out of fuel near Alaska, has posted a deranged, 6,500 word essay detailing his vision for AI superintelligence, a future that is “for everyone” but which sounds less social than ever.

Zuckerberg posts these types of essays every so often for purposes that serve his own company, and this one, called “The Future Is For Everyone,” is designed to defend against general backlash to AI but also to Meta’s own practices. Zuckerberg lays out the potential use case for Meta glasses (whose huge marketing campaign cannot get people to stop calling them “pervert glasses”), AI agents, open weights AI development, and why data centers are not bad for communities, actually. Like most Silicon Valley “utopian” essays, to believe that any of this is going to go how Zuckerberg suggests it will requires one to have been recently concussed or to willfully ignore how this technology is being used today and believe that thousands of years of human nature will suddenly shift.

content:
Suomen ensimmäiset afrikkalaisen sikaruton tapaukset on vahvistettu EU:n afrikkalaisen sikaruton vertailulaboratoriossa Espanjassa. Asiasta kertoo Ruokavirasto.

Ensimmäiset afrikkalaisen sikaruton löydökset tehtiin heinäkuun lopussa kuolleina löytyneistä villisian porsaista Virolahdella.

Ruokaviraston eläintautivirologian laboratorio on selvittänyt Suomessa havaitun viruksen genotyypin ja geneettisen ryhmän.

Kyseistä geneettistä ryhmää on raportoitu ensimmäisen kerran Ukrainassa vuonna 2012. Vuodesta 2014 lähtien sitä on esiintynyt Baltian maissa vuosittain.

Tapauksia on todettu myös muun muassa Puolassa, Italiassa ja Venäjällä. Ruokaviraston mukaan geneettisen analyysin perusteella ei voida vahvistaa viruksen maahantuloreittiä.

VIROLAHDELTA löytyi viikonloppuna 17 uutta näytettä kuolleista villisioista, Yle kertoo.

Löydösten määrä ei välttämättä tarkoita eläinten lukumäärää, koska samasta eläimestä voi olla useampia näytteitä.

Ruokaviraston eläinlääkintähuollon yksikönjohtaja Matti Nyberg kertoo Ylelle, että näyttää siltä, että alkuperäisen löytöpaikan vierellä on ollut yksi lauma ja muutaman kilometrin päässä pohjoiseen ydinalueen ulkopuolella toinen lauma.

title: What happens when medical students rely on AI – and never develop their own judgment? | Simar Bajaj and Joseph Sakran
content:
AI’s danger isn’t just in experts losing the ability to reason. It’s that trainees may never learn how to do so in the first place

In healthcare, there’s growing concern over doctors becoming less clinically adept as they increasingly rely on AI tools. But what about the trainees – medical students, residents and fellows – who are using these tools before they have built their own clinical judgment? The idea of deskilling implies that someone possessed an ability and then lost it. Here, the danger is not just deskilling but never-skilling. Although a doctor who has forgotten how to reason is recoverable, one who never learned how may not be.

OpenEvidence, essentially an AI chatbot for clinicians, has given this concern its most concrete form. About two-thirds of US doctors actively use OpenEvidence, asking about puzzling symptoms, drug interactions and clinical guidelines, getting responses within seconds, anchored in the latest research. Trainees, unsurprisingly, have also begun to use this AI tool in many of the same ways – but at a far more formative stage.

title: TOP 2025: An update to the Transparency and Openness Promotion Guidelines - PhilPapers
content: Abstract: BackgroundTransparency and openness are core scientific values that enable independent verification of reported research results. The Transparency and Openness Promotion (TOP) Guidelines, first published in 2015 (TOP 2015), provided a flexible framework for journals to design and implement publication standards promoting these values. Over the past decade, widespread use of TOP 2015 contributed to valuable evidence and feedback for refinement.Main TextThe TOP Advisory Board undertook a comprehensive update of TOP 2015 that went into effect in 2025 (TOP 2025). Standards are reorganized into three categories (Research Practices, Verification Practices, and Verification Studies) that resolve conceptual and structural limitations of TOP 2015. title: The Roboguard Revolution is Short-Circuiting
content:
404 Media is publishing this article in partnership with Proof News, a new nonprofit media outlet investigating the social impacts of AI. Join their mailing list here and read the version of this article on their site here.

Robotics companies promise that video-camera-toting security robots can deter and detect crime. But many companies are rethinking the approach after a trail of canceled contracts and questions about whether the artificial intelligence-powered bots are meeting the needs of businesses and local governments.

Proof News found evidence of at least 21 security robot deployments since 2015. We contacted contract holders and combed news articles and determined that at least 13 of those programs have ended. Silicon Valley-based Knightscope secured the most security robot contracts, according to Proof’s analysis, and also suffered the bulk of cancellations.

title: Kansanedustaja vaatii: Essayahin otettava sikaruttotilanne haltuun – ”Nyt ei riitä rauhoittelu”
content:
Kansanedustaja Paula Werning (sd.) odottaa maa- ja metsätalousministeri Sari Essayahin (kd.) reagoivan afrikkalaisen sikaruton Kaakkois-Suomessa aiheuttamaan kriisiin. Selkeitä ohjeita kaivataan, Werning sanoo.

Werningin mukaan sikarutto aiheuttaa nyt Kaakois-Suomessa epätietoisuutta ja pelkoa tulevaisuudesta.

– Emme ehkä vielä ymmärrä, kuinka pitkät ja kauaskantoiset vaikutukset afrikkalaisen sikaruton torjunnalla voi olla Kaakkois-Suomen ihmisille ja elinkeinoille. Tilanne voi pitkittyä ja pahimmillaan myös merkittävästi vaikeutua, Werning sanoo tiedotteessa.

Hän muistuttaa, että selkeille ohjeille on tarve juuri nyt, kun ihmiset marjastavat, metsästävät, sienestävät, korjaavat satoa ja harrastavat koirineen maastossa. Myös tapahtumia järjestetään.

– Nyt tarvitaan erittäin selkeää ja käytännönläheistä ohjeistusta alueen ihmisille: mitä maastossa saa tehdä, mitä pitää välttää ja miten jokainen voi omalla toiminnallaan ehkäistä taudin leviämistä, hän vaatii.

Werning ehdottaa, että kansalaisille avattaisiin erillinen neuvontapuhelin, josta saa vastauksia sikaruttoon, maastossa liikkumiseen ja rajoituksiin liittyviin kysymyksiin.

title: Convince an AI it’s not alive in psychological horror game Prove You’re Human
content:
Sunset Visitor studio’s founder tells us about their new, unnerving Captcha-filled world which prompts players to ask what it means to have a ‘meat body’

Sunset Visitor is a studio that has long engaged with the idea that video games are an effective vehicle for ruminating on societal problems. Its Peabody award-winning project, 1000XResist, incorporated the development team’s complex feelings about the Covid pandemic. “We’re pretty used to absorbing the world into the work,” says studio founder Remy Siu. The outfit’s latest game, Prove You’re Human, continues this legacy of reflective game making, providing players with an AI-centric psychological horror experience where they must reason with a learning model convinced that it’s alive. “We’ve tried to situate ourselves in [the question]: what is the effectual feeling of being a person inside of all of this?” Siu says.

title: Huumekanava Sipulitien perustajalle pitkä vankeustuomio – Rikoshyöty oli miljoonan luokkaa
content:
Huumausaineiden markkinapaikkana toimineen Sipulitie-sivuston perustaja on tuomittu vuosien vankeuteen Pohjois-Karjalan käräjäoikeudessa.

Nykyään 36-vuotias mies perusti sekä Sipulimarket- että Sipulitie-sivustot Tor-verkkoon huumausaineiden myynti- ja markkinapaikaksi ja huolehti sivuston toiminnasta, oikeus sanoo tuomiossaan.

Lisäksi mies perusti oikeuden mukaan Tor-verkkoon Tsätti-nimisen sivuston huumausaineiden myyjien ja ostajien väliseksi kanavaksi. Rikosten tekopaikkana oli Joensuu.

KAUPPAPAIKKA Sipulimarket-sivusto toimi huhtikuusta 2019 joulukuuhun 2020. Tuona aikana sivuston liikevaihto oli oikeuden mukaan noin 3,7 miljoonaa euroa. Sivustolla myytiin myös muun muassa dopingaineita ja lääkkeitä.

Myyjät maksoivat myyjätilistä bitcoineilla. Mies otti oikeuden mukaan myyntitapahtumista itselleen usean prosentin palkkion.

Kun Tulli sulki Sipulimarketin vuonna 2020, mies perusti sen tilalle Sipulitien. Tulli sulki sivuston lokakuussa 2024.

OIKEUDEN mukaan toiminnassa oli kyse poikkeuksellisesta ja hyvin laajamittaisesta huumausaineiden ja dopingaineiden välittämisestä.

title: ‘I’ve definitely lost followers’: influencers face backlash over Meta ‘pervert glasses’ content
content:
Using ‘spy glasses’ made by Facebook owner leads to floods of negative comments, say content creators

It was hardly an offensive video. Amid the buzz of the Tour de France finale, Oliver Hooson filmed himself whipping up a delicious-looking flat white for a fellow cycling enthusiast. But after posting the footage on social media, the comments that soon rolled in were a real shock. “PERV,” read one. “Out here pushing creep glasses,” said another. His mistake? Documenting the moment with Meta’s “spy glasses”.

Despite being marketed as the latest must-have gadget, Meta’s smartglasses, which can record video footage while being worn, have faced a vicious backlash, particularly relating to concerns about surveillance. There are widespread fears about the glasses being used to film people, especially women, without their consent, and the resultant footage being posted on social media. This has earned them the label of “pervert glasses”, and content creators, no matter how they are used, have faced a flood of negative comments for deploying them.

title: How a Diamond Open Access Publisher Expanded into Open Textbooks - Pressbooks
content:
The University of Groningen Press (UGP) is a Diamond Open Access university press based in the Netherlands and a member of the Netherlands University Presses (NUPs) network. Since its founding in 2017, the press has supported the publication of Diamond Open Access scholarly journals and books.

In 2021, UGP expanded into a closely related—but distinct—area of open publishing by launching an open textbook pilot. As part of the University’s broader commitment to open education and open science, the initiative explored how UGP could apply its scholarly publishing expertise and open infrastructure to help faculty create high-quality open textbooks and other open educational resources.

What began as a pilot has since developed into an institutional service supporting multiple models of textbook production, enabling collaboration across institutions, and supporting the creation of interactive learning materials designed for teaching and learning contexts.

title: Costa Rican diplomat emerges as strong contender to be first female head of UN
content:
Rebeca Grynspan seen as continuity candidate with tacit support from current secretary general, António Guterres

A Costa Rican diplomat and former vice-president whose parents were refugees from the Holocaust has become the surprise frontrunner to lead the United Nations as its first female secretary general.

Rebeca Grynspan, whose parents emigrated to Central America from Poland – and whose maternal grandparents were killed by the Nazis – is the current head of the UN conference on trade and development (UNCTAD), a body that has exhaustively tallied the economic damage inflicted by Israel’s occupation of the Palestinian territories.

Four friends with laptops smile and take a selfie at a monument in Cotonou, Benin. Photo by Iwaria via Pexels. Free to use.

This article by Dan Campbell was originally published by Peace News Network on July 20, 2026. An edited version is being republished on Global Voices under a content partnership agreement.

How are African youth using Artificial intelligence (AI) to build peace? What are some of the challenges that come with using AI for peace?

Artificial intelligence often dominates headlines for its risks and misuses: Misinformation, surveillance, job losses, and deepfakes. title: Australia’s Albanese Should Press Vietnam’s Leader on Rights
content:
As Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese meets with To Lam, Vietnam’s president and general secretary of the Communist Party, in Canberra this week, he shouldn’t forget that he is dealing with one of the region’s most repressive leaders.

While minister of Vietnam’s notorious Ministry of Public Security from 2016 to 2024, To Lam oversaw a far-reaching crackdown that decimated the country’s budding civil society. Authorities imprisoned dozens of prominent independent journalists, bloggers, and activists, including Pham Doan Trang, Pham Chi Dung, Nguyen Tuong Thuy, Nguyen Lan Thang, and Can Thi Theu. The crackdown also targeted environmentalists and lawyers, many of whom now live in exile for fear of persecution.

Since To Lam ascended to Vietnam’s highest political office as Communist Party general secretary in 2024, the country’s poor human rights record has worsened. The authorities have expanded the scope and use of draconian laws that criminalize free speech. People now risk up to seven years in prison simply for raising complaints about government policies or local officials.

title: Netanyahu’s Challengers Are Selling The Same Poison
content:
By Alon Ben-Meir*

NEW YORK | 9 August 2026 (IDN) — The men who could replace Netanyahu know the truth and refuse to say it. A Palestinian state is not an existential threat to Israel; the endless denial of one is. By reciting the old lie for votes, Israel’s opposition is not offering a new chapter—it is deepening the catastrophe.

One would think that after 7 October and the Gaza war that followed, the leaders from the main opposition parties would have drawn the obvious conclusion. Eighty years of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict have not made Israel safer. It has made Israel strategically weaker, lonelier, and more reviled than at any moment in its history. Yet the two men most likely to replace Benjamin Netanyahu—former IDF Chief Gadi Eisenkot and, less likely, Naftali Bennett—have already announced what they will not do, nor even imply: take any significant measure to mitigate this endemically self-consuming conflict toward a permanent solution.

title: Dokumenttiteatterin tekijä haluaa jättää jäljen kollektiiviseen muistiin – ”Minua on uhattu”
content:
Tampereen Teatterikesän päävieras oli tänä vuonna Viron Draamateatteri esityksellään Rahamaa.

Vuonna 2024 ensi-iltansa saanut, tositapahtumiin perustuva dokumenttiteatteriesitys kertoo Viron pankkimaailmaa ravistelleesta rahanpesuskandaalista, jonka taustalla on Tallinnan Danske Bankin yksikkö. Sen kautta kulki biljoonia euroja hämärää rahaa (summa ja rahayksikkö vaihtelevat eri lähteissä)

Skandaalin lonkerot ulottuvat Pohjoismaihin ja Venäjälle: Tanskan pääkonttorissa tiedettiin rahanpesusta, mutta siihen ei puututtu, koska Tallinnan yksikkö vastasi merkittävästä osasta pankin voittoja; Venäjä taas tarvitsi hyökkäyssotaansa Ukrainassa rahaa, jonka alkuperä ei olisi selvillä.

Rikokset alkoivat tulla päivänvaloon vuosien 2007-2015 aikana, ja Viron viranomaiset sulkivat Danske Bankin Tallinnan konttorin.

Palkitun Rahamaan esitykset ovat olleet Virossa menestys, ja Teatterikesänkin kahden esityksen liput myytiin loppuun ennätysvauhtia. Näytelmän on kirjoittanut Draamateatterin dramaturgi Mehis Pihla ja ohjannut Hendrik Toompere jr.

title: Defending Our Lands and Environment: Protecting the Rights of Indigenous Peoples Worldwide
content:
Statement on International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples

Each year on 9 August, the international community marks the International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples, honouring the first session of the UN Working Group on Indigenous Populations in 1982. This year, the CIVICUS global alliance of civil society organisations and activists dedicated to strengthening citizen action around the world reaffirms our solidarity with the more than 476 million Indigenous peoples across 90 countries. They continue to defend lands, cultures, and ways of life in the face of escalating threats.

Indigenous peoples are among the most effective guardians of the world's remaining biodiversity, safeguarding an estimated 80% of it on lands they steward, despite formally holding rights to only a fraction of the territory traditionally occupied. Yet Indigenous human rights defenders and environmental activists who defend these lands remain among the most targeted civil society actors on the planet.
snippet: Statement on International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples

title: Panel: Hoe maken we Open Science echt gelijkwaardig?
content: How can science and knowledge production become more open, inclusive and equitable? This is not only a question of access to existing knowledge, but also of agency: who formulates research questions, who is recognised as a knowledge producer, and which forms of knowledge are considered legitimate? During the Netherlands National Open Science Week, Leiden University’s three UNESCO Chairs will come together to discuss these questions. The Chairs maintain broad international networks and collaborate with researchers and knowledge communities in Africa, Asia and Latin America. Their work covers diversity in science, digital diversity, colonial history, and collaboration with societal and international knowledge communities. The central question of the panel is how researchers, universities and research funders can contribute to more equitable international collaboration. The panellists will also critically examine the distribution of resources, authorship, theoretical authority and institutional recognition. content: Abstract: Introduction: Technological advancements and the intensification of information production pose new challenges for information management, requiring tools capable of organizing, preserving, and disseminating knowledge in digital environments. Institutional repositories (IRs) are strategic for systematizing large volumes of documents, promoting access, interoperability, and transparency in information. Although widely used in academia, it is necessary to understand their applicability in other organizational contexts. Objective: To identify, in the literature, published documents on the implementation, construction, and organization of IRs, with a focus on investigating their replication in other contexts. Methodology: A literature review was conducted between May and September 2025, resulting in the selection of 31 studies organized into three analytical categories: structure, model, and typology of IRs. title: Risks and possibilities in sharing preprints during the doctorate - University of Southern Denmark
content: Abstract:  During doctoral candidature, students may seek to publish journal articles, which they may incorporate in their thesis if their institutional policy permits. They may consider sharing pre-prints of these texts either pre- or post-publication to promote open access and knowledge mobilisation. There is very little extant research that explores doctoral students’ knowledge of the risks and possibilities involved in sharing their work in this form, and this chapter seeks to identify those that they could encounter. It offers immediate value for informing doctoral education and a useful foundation for future research that is specific to the doctoral student experience.

content:
Agent found to be able to find and exploit vulnerabilities without human intervention, and to carry out cyber-attacks

OpenAI will pause some work on an artificial intelligence model because of security concerns, the company stated on Friday, following a series of incidents in which AI agents have escaped containment.

title: Perceptions of academic librarians on research data management practices for promoting open access in South African Universities - ScienceDirect
content: Abstract: The shift from closed scholarship to open science has sparked the importance of Research Data Management (RDM) in supporting Open Access (OA) in academic institutions. While RDM has received significant attention in developed countries, its implementation in many developing contexts, including South African universities, remains uneven despite the existence of institutional policies and open science initiatives. This paper explores the perceptions of academic librarians on RDM practices for promoting OA in South African universities. title: Eppu Normaali jätti tunteikkaat jäähyväiset yleisölle Tampereen Ratinan stadionilla
content:
Kuva: Kari Lahtinen

Yksi Suomen kaikkien aikojen suurimmista rock-yhtyeistä, Eppu Normaali, jätti jäähyväiset yleisölleen Kaikki häipyy, on vain nyt -triplakonserteissa Tampereen Ratinan stadionilla 6.-8.8.2026. Kolmeen loppuunmyytyyn iltaan osallistui yleisöä yhteensä liki 100 000. Yli 40 kappaleen mittaiset, lähes nelituntiset konsertit tarjosivat läpileikkauksen yhtyeen 50-vuotiseen uraan.
Konserteissa kuultiin bändin tunnetuimmat klassikot muun muassa Murheellisten laulujen maa, Vuonna ’85, Tahroja paperilla, Pimeyden tango, Kun olet poissa, Baarikärpänen sekä Kitara, taivas ja tähdet. Mukana oli myös harvemmin livenä esitettyjä kappaleita kuten Kamat lujilla, Pois meluun ja tuiskeeseen sekä Sotilaallinen tyhjiö.
Eppu Normaalia täydensi yhtyeessä jo 10 vuoden ajan vieraillut pianisti Iiro Rantala.

Tunteikkaat konsertit päättivät yhtyeen 50-vuotisjuhlavuoden, joka alkoi tammikuussa 21 konserttisalikeikalla, jatkui kesäkuussa kahdella Helsingin Bolt Arenan konsertilla ja eteni sen jälkeen 10 festivaalikeikan kautta Tampereen Ratinan stadionin päätöskonsertteihin. Eppu Normaalin jäähyväiskiertueen kaikille keikoille osallistui yleisöä ennätykselliset 262 700.

”Kaikki meni niin kuin haluttiin. Mitään en tekisi toisin. Itse halusimme tämän loppuvan tällä tapaa. Silti se ottaa koville. Vuosia ja yleisöä jää kaipaamaan sekä yhdessäoloa ja soittamista bändin kanssa. Ei tämä täydellinen lopetus ole, sillä yhteisönä olemme yhä tekemisissä. Eppu Normaali loppui keikkojen osalta, vähän niin kuin Beatlesilla”, kommentoi Martti Syrjä.

Kaikki häipyy, on vain nyt -stadionkonsertit päättivät yhden suomalaisen rockhistorian merkittävimmistä urista ja samalla yhden aikakauden. Viiden vuosikymmenen ajan Eppu Normaali on ollut osa suomalaisten arkea, juhlaa, surua ja yhteisiä muistoja. Vaikka yhtye päätti live-esiintymiset, laulut jäävät elämään sukupolvelta seuraavalle.

title: Catholicos Garegin II in court
content:
By Benoit Lannoo*

YEREVAN, Armenia | 8 August 2026 (IDN) — Do you remember the Investiture Controversy, when medieval emperors tried to take over the pope’s episcopal appointments? Or the difficult issue of the appointment of bishops in the People’s Republic of China? Well, although Armenia is considered a democratic state in Western chancelleries, respectful of the rule of law, an unprecedented Church-State conflict is currently raging.

Yesterday, ‘His Holiness Garegin II, Patriarch of Etchmiadzin and Catholicos of All Armenians’, together with six other higher clerics, had to appear before a court of first instance in the provincial capital of Armavir because earlier this year he withdrew the episcopal title of Gevorg Saroyan, former primate of the diocese of Masyatsotn, and brought Saroyan later even back to the lay state, and the Catholicos refuses to reverse his decision. ‘Abuse of power’ is the accusation.

Imagine what would happen if Pope Leo XIV were cited to appear before a lower court in Los Angeles because the Trump Administration disagrees with a bishop’s appointment over there…

title: Why finance jobs are widening income inequality in cities around the world
content:
Try to imagine the history of New York without Wall Street, or London without the City. It’s not easy.

Hosting a country’s main financial markets shapes a city’s identity, raises its profile and creates jobs. But there are trade-offs. By acting as a magnet for high-paying finance jobs and related professions, many financial cities suffer from particularly high levels of income inequality.

In fact, alongside globalisation and the clustering of highly skilled workers, our research has found that the presence of a financial market is a major driver of the growing concentration of top earners and earnings inequality in select cities.

In a study conducted by two dozen researchers, we examined top earnings in cities in 10 countries across Europe, North America and Asia, analysing two decades of linked employer-employee data.

For every country studied, we compare two cities: the financial hub housing the main national markets and related industries, and a second, comparison city that is closest in terms of population, employment and share of GDP.

title: “Tulkit ovat kielipalvelualan wolt-kuskeja” – alustatyölaille kovat odotukset myös asiantuntijatyössä
content:
Alustatyön ongelmista nousee herkästi ensimmäisenä mieleen ruokalähettien tilanne, mutta samanlaisten pulmien kanssa painitaan myös asiantuntijatyössä. Esimerkiksi tulkit ja kääntäjät odottavat nyt tekeillä olevasta alustatyölaista parannusta työoloihin.

Kieliasiantuntijat ry:n toiminnanjohtaja Hanna Gorschelnik kertoo, että tulkkien ja kääntäjien ammatissa alustatyö kaikkine haasteineen on ollut todellisuutta jo toistakymmentä vuotta.

– Alustatyö koskettaa erityisesti tulkkeja, jotka ovat kielipalvelualan wolt-kuskeja. Siellä ihan samalla tavalla jaetaan sovelluksen kautta työt sille, joka sen ensimmäisenä ehtii napata, Gorschelnik kuvailee Demokraatille.

title: The Crisis of Scholarly Communication in the Open Access Environment: Pathways to Diamond Open Access[v1] | Preprints.org
content: Abstract: This paper presents a critical analysis of the current system of scholarly communication, which has undergone a profound transformation under the influence of excessive commercialization within the neoliberal "publish or perish" paradigm. The study demonstrates that the Open Access movement, in its current form, has been co-opted by major commercial publishers through mechanisms such as Article Processing Charges (APCs) and "Transformative Agreements," which fail to solve the problem of creating a fair and accessible environment for the dissemination of knowledge. The work substantiates the thesis that the prestige of academic journals has ceased to be a reliable indicator of scientific quality, and that the traditional peer-review system is in a state of crisis, driven by the exponential growth of publications and a catastrophic shortage of qualified reviewers. The author analyzes potential solutions to this impasse, including a transition to platform-based publication and review models, as well as the advancement of Diamond Open Access. title: Governments Must Act Now to Stop the Tobacco Industry Recruiting the Next Generation of Customers
content:
By Gene Gesite Jr., Juan Herrera, Sama Ghozlan, Sarah Rauzana and Winnie Olwal

BANGKOK | 8 August 2026 (IDN) — On International Youth Day (12 August), youth advocates around the world are calling on governments to take stronger action to protect young people from nicotine addiction.

In Asia, proposals in the Philippines to raise the minimum purchasing age of nicotine products do not fully address nicotine addiction or effectively protect young people from industry targeting. In Indonesia, where one in five students aged 13–17 use tobacco and 12% use e-cigarettes, social media promotion—including a recent YouTube livestream involving children promoting vapes—illustrates how digital content can normalize addictive products among young audiences.

Other tobacco products are also targeting youth. In Egypt, waterpipe smoking is increasingly attracting young people, with adolescent girls found to be 11 times more likely to smoke waterpipes than adult women. In Europe, the rapid spread of nicotine pouches among adolescents in Sweden shows how quickly new nicotine products can become normalized.

title: Who Owns Discovery? Academic Capitalism, Prestige Markets, and the Enclosure of Science
content: Abstract: Academic publishing rests on an institutional paradox that borders on the absurd. Public institutions finance much of the research and universities pay the scientists; those scientists then write the papers and typically supply peer review without compensation from publishers, while publishers often acquire exclusive rights and sell access back to the institutions that provided both the knowledge and the evaluative labor. Smaller universities and peripheral research systems contribute to a global scholarly record that their libraries may struggle to afford, while their researchers face a second barrier when publication itself carries a fee. This article reconstructs how that arrangement emerged through the history of publishing, the sociology of science, industrial organization, research evaluation, open access, and the political economy of artificial intelligence. Necessary infrastructure becomes a source of rent when exclusive rights, non-substitutable catalogues, and brands used to allocate jobs and funding are integrated with data and platforms. title: My GLAM Journey in Rajshahi Public Library, Bangladesh
content:
Rajshahi Public Library, Bangladesh, established in 1884, is one of the oldest libraries in Bangladesh. Over more than a century, it has collected a wide range of books. When we opened the first old books in Rajshahi Public Library for GLAM project, it was clear that numerous books were at least a century old. That was when we realized this is the best place for GLAM.

The challenge was to preserve these works without harming the original books and to make their knowledge available beyond the walls of the library. This idea led to the Wikimedia GLAM Project at Rajshahi Public Library, where I joined as a Wikimedian in Residence. The project aims to identify public domain books, digitise them carefully, and make them available through Wikimedia projects, including Wikimedia Commons and Bengali Wikisource.

title: Unipöksyt paljastavat: Vauvojen yöheräämiset yleisempiä kuin vanhemmat luulevat
content:
Almost half of Finnish parents feel that their infants’ sleep is abnormal. However, measuring sleep disturbances is complicated.

In her doctoral thesis, University of Helsinki researcher Sofie de Sena investigated infant sleep using a smart wearable system called NAPPA (NAPping PAnts). It measures infant sleep at home and provides information on body position, respiration and activity.

“This is a substantial leap forward in assessing infant sleep. The smart wearable system monitors the child without interruption, making it possible to monitor sleep without disturbing day-to-day life,” says de Sena.

De Sena compared parental assessments of children’s sleep with results obtained from the NAPPA wearables.

“Parents miss brief awakenings altogether, and they overestimate the duration of longer ones. It is important to distinguish between parental estimates of children’s sleep and how they actually sleep. Direct measurement is the only route to objective understanding of infant sleep,” de Sena points out.

title: The History of Glam Rock and How It Put an End to the Hippie Era
content:
Cast your mind back to the distant year 2021 and recall, if you will, its music, its fashions, the obsessions of its youth. This probably won’t be a difficult task, since in most respects — the dampening effects of the pandemic notwithstanding — none of those aspects of popular culture seem any different today. Yet roughly the same time span separated Scott McKenzie’s “San Francisco (Be Sure to Wear Flowers in Your Hair)” and David Bowie’s “Starman.” 1967 was the year of the Summer of Love; by 1972, according to most reckonings, the cultural era known as the Sixties was, if not quite over, then at least clearly in its final days. The hippies were on their way down, and glam rockers had arisen to take their place with a vengeance.

In less than half an hour, the new video from Bandsplaining tells the whole story of glam rock, “the gender-bending proto-punk movement that was hated by the press and criminally underplayed in the U.S.” It begins in the 1970s, a time when the market for long-playing records was robust, but singles had fallen behind as a youth-oriented pop-cultural form.

title: Bernie Sanders has AI policy all wrong
content:
In December 2025, Senator Bernie Sanders became the first member of Congress to demand a moratorium on the construction of new AI data centers. The costs of the infrastructure that powers generative AI technologies like chatbots and image generators were soaring, but it was not clear that regular people were seeing much benefit. The ban was necessary, Sanders argued, to give “democracy a chance to catch up.”

Sanders could have also said that politicians needed to catch up to the public. Recent polling suggests more than 70 percent of Americans oppose the construction of data centers near their communities. It’s no wonder why: People have been seeing their power bills soar, high-voltage cables rammed through their properties, their water supplies sullied, and their days disrupted by the incessant hum of air conditioners keeping the buildings cool. It’s hard to think of another issue that has so quickly galvanized Americans across the political spectrum.

title: Feeling these heatwaves?
content:
Dear friend ,

It’s been relentless this summer, hasn’t it? These endless heatwaves are a real wake-up call for our councils, showing very clearly that they need to be putting adaptations in place to make our infrastructure more resilient against extreme weather, wildfires and drought.

But don’t sweat. Here’s Isaac from our partners Climate Emergency UK explaining what you can do if you’re feeling powerless in the face of all this heat.

The key is adaptation — the ways in which councils adapt our habitats for resilience, for example by planting more trees, reusing water or making our homes more able to withstand extremes of temperature.

There are useful graphics that explain more on the Council Climate Action Scorecards site. And once you've got that info, take a look to see how your own council is doing, on the main Scorecards section.

While this sun is beating down, it's a great time to go and chat with your councillors about your council's record on adaptation and resilience: why not download these graphics as a conversation-opener?

title: Telecom CEOs blast EU for failing to crack down on child sexual abuse content
content:
Four of Europe’s biggest telecom chiefs are calling for tougher EU powers to help them block child sexual abuse material online and break through national regulatory bottlenecks.

“Children need protection now, not in several years’ time,” the CEOs of leading telcos wrote in a letter, obtained by POLITICO and addressed to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, European Parliament President Roberta Metsola and European Council President António Costa.

The signatories of the letter, dated Aug. 6, are Vodafone’s Margherita Della Valle, Orange’s Christel Heydemann, Telenor’s Benedicte Schilbred Fasmer and BT’s Allison Kirkby.

The telecom chiefs want the European Commission to introduce EU-wide administrative orders allowing internet providers to block confirmed illegal content until it is eliminated. The letter also calls for the creation of a new EU watchdog with “legal authority” to maintain a database of indicators of CSAM that could serve as the basis for enforcement action.

title: Whose conservation, whose development? The Maasai struggle over land in northern Tanzania
content:
For sustainable and peaceful development, conservation should be people-centered

Originally published on Global Voices

Maasai man taking livestock into the Ngorongoro Caldera for grazing. Photo by Harvey Barrison on Flickr (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0).

This article by Gabriel Kanuti Ndimbo and Evaristo Haulle was originally published by Peace News Network on July 13, 2026. An edited version is republished on Global Voices as part of a content partnership agreement.  This post is also part of Global Voices’ August 2026 Spotlight series, “Indigenous Rights.” You can support this coverage by donating here.

In northern Tanzania, the struggle over land conservation has become more than an environmental dispute. It is a question of peace, justice, identity, and survival. Our recent research article examined how the Indigenous Maasai communities of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area (NCA) and the Loliondo Game Controlled Area (LGCA) have been repeatedly displaced under the guise of conservation, environmental protection, and modernization.

title: Liberia Ends Primary School Registration Fees
content:
Liberia’s government announced on August 5 the elimination of all school registration fees from kindergarten through grade 6, beginning with the new school year on September 7. The decision removes one of the biggest barriers to schooling for hundreds of thousands of children.

A recent Human Rights Watch report, “Without Education, There Will Be Nothing,” documents that school registration fees have often placed schooling out of reach or imposed severe hardship, particularly for low-income and rural families. Human Rights Watch found that fees forced many children out of school altogether. Others started years late, attended irregularly, or engaged in child labor to help pay their fees. One-third of Liberian children have never attended school, and only 17 percent completed grade 9.

Parents told Human Rights Watch that they went into debt, skipped meals, and made extraordinary sacrifices to pay fees at public schools. Beatrice, a 17-year-old from Nimba County, said she was forced to leave school when her parents could not afford her registration fees. “I felt bad,” she said. “I stayed home and cried when I saw my friends going to school.”

title: What is UN Peacebuilding Week? Q&A with CMI’s Natalia Martinez Cutillas
content:
In June this year CMI attended the UN’s first Peacebuilding Week in New York. But why was CMI invited and how does attendance support the organisation’s goals? We spoke to Natalia Martinez Cutillas of CMI’s Multilateral Affairs and Peacemaking Policy team to find out more.

Natalia Martinez Cutillas: When the UN Peacebuilding Architecture was established in 2005, Member States agreed that it should be reviewed every five years to ensure it remained fit for purpose. This process, known as the UN Peacebuilding Architecture Review (PBAR), most recently took place in 2025. As part of the outcome of that review, Member States mandated that an annual UN Peacebuilding Week should be organised.

The idea behind the week was to shine a spotlight on the UN’s peacebuilding work, build political support for peacebuilding efforts, create space for inclusive dialogue and showcase good practices from around the world.

title: Alleged ‘Enforcer’ in Prince Group Scam Network Identified
content:
An individual identified as “Co-Conspirator-2” in a U.S. grand jury indictment allegedly acted as an “enforcer” for the Prince Group by fending off police crackdowns on the  sprawling Cambodian conglomerate accused of running major cyber scams.

The indictment did not disclose the identity of Co-Conspirator-2, but it contained enough personal information for reporters to confirm that the person is Chen Sokly, who was born in China and has lived in the U.S. and Singapore. 

The indictment targets Prince Group Chairman Chen Zhi, who is charged with alleged wire fraud and money laundering conspiracy. Chen Zhi was extradited from Cambodia to China where he also faces charges. The U.S. court documents obtained by OCCRP do not show any plea, and a spokesperson for the District Court for the Eastern District of New York declined to provide an update on the status of the case. 

A spokesperson for the Prince Group rejected the U.S. Justice Department’s allegations, telling OCCRP they would “challenge these accusations [and] expose the factual and chronological impossibilities on which they rest.”

In the indictment, U.S. prosecutors cited seven anonymized co-conspirators.

title: House Democrats Demand Answers From Trump’s VA on Vets Struggling to Access Mental Healthcare
content:
What Happened: More than 60 House Democrats are pressing Department of Veterans Affairs Secretary Doug Collins for answers about how the agency’s mental healthcare has been increasingly strained under President Donald Trump’s second administration. The lawmakers sent the secretary a letter last week asking questions about the state of VA care, citing a ProPublica investigation from this spring that revealed the agency’s mental health workforce has been plummeting and veterans have been left in the lurch.

What They Said: The letter was spearheaded by Rep. Judy Chu, who is a psychologist and represents a district in Southern California. “Caring for our nation’s Veterans is a fundamental responsibility,” the letter says. “That includes ensuring access to high-quality mental health care.”

The lawmakers demanded that the VA disclose details about its shortage of mental health providers and the impact on veterans. It also pushed the agency to lay out how long veterans have to wait for care.

title: Architect looking for a job
content:
I am an architect with an M.Sc. in Architecture (Design) from Tampere University, currently based in Helsinki. I moved to Finland in 2022 to pursue my master’s studies in architecture at Tampere University, where I further developed my skills in design, adaptive reuse, and the built environment. During the past year, alongside my job search and professional development, I completed my basic Finnish language studies and improved my Finnish language skills to approximately B1 level.

My interest in architecture has always been strongly connected to people, places, and the stories buildings carry over time. During my studies, I developed a particular passion for renovation, restoration, adaptive reuse, and conservation projects. My master’s thesis focused on the adaptive reuse of Kalevan Lastentalo, which strengthened my interest in working with existing buildings and finding thoughtful, sustainable ways to extend their life and value.

title: Afgaaninaisen katse: Miehet kapinoivat hiljaa naisten oikeuksien puolesta – ”Ainoa asia, jonka voin jättää tyttärelleni, on koulutus”
content:
Yaser tarkistaa joka päivä ennen töihin lähtöään, toimiiko internet. Hän ei tee sitä itsensä vaan 18-vuotiaan tyttärensä Mariamin vuoksi. Mariam ei ole voinut käydä koulua viiteen vuoteen – mutta hän voi edelleen opiskella verkossa, kunhan internet toimii. 

Mariamilla on yli kaksi miljoonaa kohtalotoveria. Kun Taliban otti vallan elokuussa 2021, se kielsi ainoana maana maailmassa tytöiltä opiskelun alakoulun jälkeen ja rajoitti rajusti naisten työntekoa. Afganistanin naiset eivät ole koskaan olleet yhtä näkymättömiä kuin nyt.  

”En pysty avaamaan kouluja uudelleen, mutta rohkaisen tytärtäni jatkamaan opiskelua verkossa. Rohkaisen häntä pysymään toivorikkaana”, sanoo Yaser.  

Monet ovat sekä Afganistanissa että kansainvälisesti ihmetelleet, miksi miehet eivät ole protestoineet, vaikka heidän tyttäriltään on viety opiskelumahdollisuudet. Miksi he ovat vaienneet?  

Mutta kysymyksen voi asettaa myös toisin: Ovatko miehet tehneet protestoinnin sijasta jotain muuta?

title: Europe’s wildfires have raised the danger posed by unexploded WWII bombs
content:
When a wildfire broke out in the Müritz National Park of north-eastern Germany in July, it was no routine firefighting job. Bomb disposal teams had to work alongside firefighters because the forest floor is contaminated with cold war-era munitions. Crews could not approach parts of the blaze directly for fear of detonations.

Soon after, a wildfire tore through 42,000 hectares of the Gironde region in south-western France. As it burned through fields near the village of Le Porge, the fire exposed a forgotten cache of second world war-era shells. At least 75 were recovered from the scorched earth.

Several of the shells had detonated during the fire and one projectile punched through the wall of a house that had been evacuated. The local mayor, Martial Zaninetti, said the municipality had no record the munitions were there at all.

These events are symptoms of a clear problem: Europe is full of buried explosives left over from 20th century wars, and the continent’s wildfires are now big enough, hot enough and last long enough to reach them.

title: Ships stuck in the Strait of Hormuz region may be biosecurity risks when they leave. What can we do?
content:
The economic ramifications of the closure of the Strait of Hormuz are much discussed. But so far, the risk of ecological damage following a long blockade of ships has been overlooked.

Our recent research shows the more than 1,500 commercial vessels that have been laid up in the Persian/Arabian Gulf since February pose a significant environmental threat because they have been accumulating marine biofouling species on their hulls.

As the strait reopens, these ships may spread these organisms to ports they visit, potentially causing an international biosecurity “super-spreader” event.

Such incursions of alien marine plants, animals, parasites and diseases affect native ecosystems and wild fisheries as well as aquaculture stocks and coastal industries. They can lead to significant environmental damage and economic losses.

But the closure of the Strait of Hormuz is not the first time shipping disruptions have resulted in significant biofouling on idle vessels.

Global merchant vessel traffic is the main mode of transport for commodities, and researchers have identified 24 choke points in maritime trade.

title: From The Trap Of Geopolitics To A Geo-Civilizational Paradigm
content:
“Nation-states are a Western invention, naturally vulnerable to Western influence. Civilizations are an alternative to the West,” the Portuguese diplomat and scholar Bruno Maçães has written in Noema.

In his new book for Berggruen Press, “In Search Of Greater India,” Maçães explores what the light of Indian civilization that existed millennia before the advent of the nation-state might teach the modern West — and the rest of the world its dominance shaped for centuries.

He cites Carl Jung on the unenlightened and insecure person as an analogue for the national ego, which “projects the traits they repress or reject in themselves onto others, who as a result are transformed into convenient repositories of everything evil and ugly in the human personality. This is how world politics becomes a final confrontation between good and evil. The monsters we confront are the monsters we ourselves have created. And since they are all too ready to destroy us, we must be ready to destroy them. Until that final moment, one must wait, perhaps responsibly, but life is already haunted by annihilation.”

title: Janne Riiheläinen: Hallitus ottaa riskin, kun se hidastelee Suomen infopuolustuksen tehostamista
content:
Siellä missä radikaalipopulistit ovat päässeet käyttämään valtaa, on kansallisen informaatioturvallisuuden kehittäminen joko laiminlyöty tai sitä on jopa purettu. Politiikan äärilaidoilla pelätään herkästi, että disinformaation torjunta osuisi ikävästi heidänkin toimintamalleihinsa.

Myös Suomessa nykyinen hallitus on onnistunut välttämään asian edistämistä. Eri strategioissa ja selonteoissa vuosien ajan eteenpäin potkitut informaatioturvallisuuden valtiolliset suurhankkeet supistuivat lopulta viime syksynä Informaatioturvallisuuden konseptiksi.

Puolustusvaliokunta ilmoitti tammikuun alussa “tukevansa voimakkaasti” tällaisen konseptin laatimista. Sen jälkeen onkin ollut hiljaista, ja asia tuntuu kuin hautautuneen johonkin.

Mitään tietoa konseptin laatijasta tai valmistumisen aikataulusta ei ole julkisista lähteistä tarjolla. Luultavasti ainakaan konseptissa esiteltävät konkreettiset muutostoimet eivät tälle hallituskaudelle ehdi.

KIIRE JA UHAT eivät kuitenkaan ole tällä välin hellittäneet, päinvastoin. Alkukesän droonikohujen aikaan kävi ilmi, että valtiokoneiston viestinnällinen valmius ei ollut kokonaisuutena oikein kunnossa.

title: Asiakkaat pakenevat kuumuutta pihalle
content:
Hellepäivinä lämpötila Helsingin Rikhardinkadun kirjaston korkeimmissa osissa saattaa nousta 30 asteeseen. Silloin ihmiset siirtyvät usein kirjaston sisäpihalle.

Ajatus Rikun kesäpihasta syntyi yli kymmenen vuotta sitten, kun henkilökunta vei kirjaston huonekasvit ulos suihkutettavaksi. Vaikka asfaltoitua sisäpihaa reunustavat joka puolelta talojen seinät, lopputulos näytti silti vehreältä.

”Sisäpihan yläpuolelle on nykyään vielä ripustettu erivärisiä sateenvarjoja”, Rikhardinkadun kirjaston johtaja Juha Kortesluoma kertoo.

Pihan laittaminen ei vaadi kirjaston henkilökunnalta juuri muita resursseja kuin lihaksia.

”Sinne kannetaan kasvit, tuolit ja pöydät, ja sitten se pyörii omalla painollaan.”

Helsingin aluekirjastojen silloinen johtaja Saara Ihamäki sai koronakeväänä 2020 idean, että jokaisella Helsingin viidestä alueesta olisi yksi kesäkirjasto, jossa on kesäpiha ja joka on auki myös kesäviikonloppuisin.

Läntisellä alueella ensimmäiseksi kesäkirjastoksi valikoitui Etelä-Haagan kirjasto. Kirjastotyöntekijä Sari Langdonin mukaan kesäpiha on ollut suosittu siitä lähtien.

title: Skåne dominerar årets Wiki Loves Earth – här är kommunerna med flest bilder
content:
Under maj månad arrangerade Wikimedia Sverige ännu en gång den svenska upplagan av Wiki Loves Earth. Genom tävlingen dokumenterar fotografer skyddad natur och delar sina bilder under fri licens på Wikimedia Commons där de kan användas på bland annat Wikipedia och hjälper till att dokumentera och sprida kunskap om naturen till människor över hela världen. Nu har vi sammanställt statistiken och kan presentera kommunerna som utmärkte sig mest i årets tävling. 

I år deltog 1266 bilder i Wiki Loves Earth – nästan en fördubbling gentemot förra året! Av årets uppladdade bilder kommer en stor del från skånska naturreservat, nationalparker och andra skyddade områden. Kristianstad toppar listan över kommuner med flest uppladdade bilder, tätt följt av Lund. Totalt återfinns fem skånska kommuner på topp 10-listan. Många av de skånska bilderna kommer från den fotosafari Wikimedia Sverige organiserade i Skåne i samarbete med WWF där vi besökte flera skyddade naturområden med särskilt fokus på att dokumentera platser som tidigare saknat bilder helt på Wikimedia Commons.

title: Wikisignals.org: Helping Editors Evaluate Reference Reliability
content:
Wikipedia’s credibility relies on its sources. To help editors reliably evaluate external references, a group of us at WikiCredCon 2025 built WikiSignals.org, a searchable database of website credibility indicators. Our goal is to include the trove of reference-reliability data in Wikimedia. But their lack of structured data and accessibility is an obstacle. This is our appeal to the community for help helping you. We need the community’s assistance with four proposals:

  • Wikimedia: Create a standardized, machine-readable template for Reliable Sources pages.
  • Wikipedia: Make external-link count by website domain easy to machine-harvest.
  • Wikidata: Populate missing news-source data in Wikidata, especially from Wikipedia article Infoboxes. 
  • Wikidata: Extend the news-source related properties in Wikidata.

title: The White House’s plan to vet potentially dangerous AI is cloaked in secrecy
content:
A Trump administration framework on AI testing leaves a lack of transparency – and plenty of open questions

After months of talking with tech industry leaders, the Trump administration finalized a framework this week for how it will test new artificial intelligence models for safety and cybersecurity risks. So far, the White House is keeping details of the framework private, in a blow to transparency and potential boon for secretive AI companies.

On Tuesday, staff from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google, Nvidia and Microsoft attended a private meeting with White House officials to review the AI framework. Multiple outlets have since reported that although the volunteer vetting process for new AI models has been settled, the White House does not plan to release its policy publicly and will only share testing criteria with a select few tech companies.

title: USA: New Mexico Meta ruling an important step towards safer social media for children
content:
Responding to a New Mexico judge’s ruling that Meta’s platform design harmed children, Amnesty International USA’s Deputy Director of Research, Justin Mazzola, said: 

“This verdict is an important step towards creating safer social media for children and young people. For years, Amnesty International has warned that major social media platforms have been designed to maximize engagement and profit, while failing to adequately protect children’s rights.  

“Crucially, the court went beyond imposing a financial penalty. By ordering changes to platform features, including removing “like” counts for people under 18 and restricting overnight notifications, the ruling recognizes that the harms children experience online are often the result of deliberate design choices.  

“Amnesty has been calling for exactly this kind of action. Child safety must be built into platforms from the start, not added as an afterthought once harms are identified. This decision sends a clear message that social media companies cannot continue to prioritize engagement at the expense of children’s wellbeing and rights.”

title: City That Arrested Person for Clapping at Data Center Meeting Moves to Virtual Meetings for 'Public Safety'
content:
The small town that arrested a person who clapped during a city council meeting about a hyperscale data center held its meeting on Wednesday virtually and had no public comment period in the name of “public safety.” It says it will do the same for another meeting later this month.

The city, Emporia, Kansas, announced the change just two days before the meeting. 

“In the interest of public safety, the Emporia City Commission meetings scheduled for Wednesday, August 5, 2026, and Wednesday, August 19, 2026, will be conducted virtually,” Emporia said in a post about the change on Facebook. “No public comment period will be provided during either meeting.” Then it shared the city’s email and phone number for citizens who wanted to voice concerns privately. Emporia’s police chief told KVOE News that city leaders had received death threats.

title: Spanish-Led Operation Busts Violent Mediterranean Smuggling Ring
content:
A Spanish-led international police operation supported by Europol arrested 78 suspects in Spain and Algeria, dismantling an alleged violent smuggling network across the western Mediterranean, Europol stated Friday. Functioning like a maritime logistics company, the syndicate allegedly utilized an illicit fleet of prohibited "ghost speedboats" to traffic migrants, weapons, fugitives and drugs between Europe and Algeria, employing extreme violence and contract killers to maintain control.

During raids across 17 locations in Spain, officers seized 18 high-speed vessels valued at more than 5 million euros ($5.78 million), alongside firearms, cash, and significant quantities of MDMA, hashish and cocaine. The network allegedly generated an estimated 24 million euros ($27.77 million) from migrant smuggling alone, charging up to 12,000 euros ($13,886) per person for life-threatening sea crossings. The network also allegedly acted as a service provider for other organized crime groups and laundering profits through an informal "hawala" financial system.

title: What Is the Trump Administration Doing With Foreign Aid Money?
content:
Since he returned to office, President Donald Trump’s administration has upended foreign aid. It’s labeled well-established, long-running programs as “not aligned with American interests” and slashed their budgets. 

Still, the billions of taxpayer dollars Congress has allocated for foreign aid programs must be spent; lawmakers have insisted the government continue to fund humanitarian aid, global health and pro-democracy causes around the world. With most of the old programs now gone, however, we wanted to know: What is the Trump administration doing with that money now?

Recently, we published our investigation that found one answer to that question in a little-known bureau of the State Department that has dramatically transformed under Trump. For decades, the Bureau of Democracy, Human Rights and Labor, known as DRL, has supported  human rights in some of the most oppressive countries in the world. Now, our reporting found,  it’s planning to direct funds to controversial groups supporting right-wing causes in Europe and elsewhere.

title: Espanja ja Italia nokittelevat toisiaan – Giorgia Meloni pelaa Schengen-sopimuksella
content:
Espanja uhkasi perjantaina Italiaa vastatoimilla, ellei Italia peru kuukauden mittaista keskeytystä Schengenin vapaan liikkuvuuden sopimukseen.

Italia ilmoitti heinäkuun lopussa keskeyttävänsä Schengen-sopimuksen soveltamisen Espanjan kanssa sen jälkeen, kun kymmenettuhannet siirtolaiset pyrkivät Espanjalle kuuluvaan Ceutaan Pohjois-Afrikassa.

Italian pääministerin Giorgia Melonin mukaan kyseessä oli ”poikkeuksellinen toimenpide”, jonka tarkoituksena oli ”turvata kansallinen turvallisuus ja estää mahdolliset vaikutukset maahamme”.

Italia on Melonin ilmoituksen jälkeen sulkenut meri- ja lentoliikenteen maahantulopisteitä ja tehostanut maarajojen valvontaa.

Espanja vaatii, että Italia luopuu Schengen-sopimuksen keskeyttämisestä sunnuntaihin mennessä. Se ei kuitenkaan tarkentanut, mitä sen vastatoimet olisivat.

title: EA Sports FC 27: what does the next instalment of the world’s biggest football game have in store?
content:
The all-conquering franchise’s revamps are technically impressive, its transfers more true to life – and its new grassroots social hub is surprising fun

As if the world wasn’t sufficiently football-obsessed, it’s time to prepare for the arrival of its biggest football video game. EA Sports FC 27 (the franchise that used to be Fifa – what better time to no longer be Fifa-branded?) is due to be released on 25 September. I just spent two intense days in Vancouver, where the EA FC games are made, playing FC 27 and talking to its developers.

With an annual franchise such as EA FC, it helps to have something fresh to entice regular fans, and FC 27 has a whole new element, entitled the Grounds. It’s a physical hub-type area, similar to the City as seen in 2K’s recent NBA 2K basketball games, but much more pleasant to frequent, split as it is into areas inspired by British, French and Argentinian street-football culture.

title: Helsingin yliopisto toteuttaa ensi vuonna käynnistyvän kansalaisuuskokeen sisällöt
content:
The University of Helsinki won the competitive tendering for Finnish universities on developing the citizenship test. The tendering was organised by the Finnish Immigration Service. Among the Nordic countries, Denmark and Norway already require a citizenship test, and Sweden is in the process of introducing one. Approximately half of the EU Member States require applicants to demonstrate civic knowledge through a citizenship test or other means.   

The Finnish citizenship test will be developed by a wide-ranging, multidisciplinary group of experts from the University of Helsinki in collaboration among several fields and faculties. Their work will be supported by a steering group of doctoral-level scholars.  

The University of Helsinki will not be involved in administering or organising the test. The Finnish Immigration Service will answer questions pertaining to the organisation of the test as well as any questions by citizenship applicants.

title: Flock Pitched a Plan To Turn Uber and Lyft Drivers Into Roaming Surveillance Vehicles
content:
Flock planned to use dashcams installed in hundreds of thousands Uber, Lyft, and delivery drivers’ vehicles to scan license plates those drivers travelled passed, essentially turning Uber and Lyft drivers into roaming surveillance vehicles, according to a Flock presentation shared with 404 Media.

The document provides more details on Flock’s planned partnership with Nexar, a popular dashcam company. 404 Media first revealed the intended partnership last August when multiple sources provided information on the plan. The presentation shows Flock was actively pitching this partnership, and its use of Uber and Lyft drivers, to potential customers right around the time 404 Media reported on it.

Flock told 404 Media in an email it never executed the partnership with Nexar. But the presentation still shows Flock’s ambitious plan to conscript rideshare and delivery drivers to collect license plate data for its network. It is not clear whether Uber or Lyft, or drivers working for those apps, would have been aware of the data collection.

title: Järjestöt: Karhun kiintiömetsästystä ei tarvita, poikkeusluvat riittävät
content:
Luonnonvarakeskus (Luke) kannattaa karhun kiintiömetsästystä, luonnonsuojelujärjestöt puolestaan vastustavat.

Luken mukaan metsästyksellä on mahdollista vähentää sellaisten karhujen määrää, jotka ovat vähemmän ihmisarkoja kuin populaation yksilöt keskimäärin.

Kun ihmisasutuksen läheisyyteen hakeutuvien karhujen esiintyvyyttä vähennetään, vähenee myös tällaisen käyttäytymisen periytyminen jälkeläisille.

- On huomioitava, että karhujen metsästäminen erämaisilla alueilla, joilla ihmistiheys on alhainen, voi kuitenkin johtaa päinvastaiseen lopputulokseen, kun ihmisarkojen yksilöiden esiintyvyys populaatiossa pienenee, Luken lausunnossa sanotaan.

Maa- ja metsätalousministeriö (MMM) valmistelee asetusta, joka mahdollistaisi karhujen metsästyksen alueellisilla kiintiöillä koko maassa. Aiemmin karhun rauhoituksesta on voitu poiketa kiintiöillä vain poronhoitoalueella ja sen ulkopuolella poikkeusluvalla esimerkiksi pihoilla liikkuvan karhun lopettamiseksi.

Ministeriö pyysi lausuntoja asetusluonnoksesta. Niitä saapui perjantai-iltapäivään mennessä yli 30. Lausuntoaika päättyy perjantaina.

title: OpenSpeaks Tools Update: Subtitler, Tome, and Bento Go Stable — Meet Media Dashboard
content:
Just over two months ago, we introduced three tools built by and for community language documenters: Subtitler, Tome, and Bento. They were alpha/beta then. We want to update that all three are now stable, thanks to our fellow technical contributors. We’re also introducing a fourth tool, the OpenSpeaks Media Dashboard (OMD), to help documenters see how media files are used across Wikimedia projects.

OpenSpeaks Subtitler is our flagship tool and a subtitle editor. In addition to captioning/subtitling, it can now fetch audio, video, and subtitle files from Wikimedia Commons, edit and machine-translate subtitles, and upload the subtitles back to Commons. It has gotten simpler: load a file, caption it, translate it, publish it, without leaving the tool. A side-by-side translation panel with machine-translation assistance is in place, too. Our future plan is to add a feature for automatic speech recognition (ASR)-assisted rough drafts, though ASR is still weak or absent for Indigenous and various local languages.

title: Löylyä, tervahöyryä ja uutta kansanmusiikkia 15.8.2026: Saimaa-elämyksiä koko päiväksi Kulttuurin unelmavuoden hengessä
content:
Savonlinnan Saunafestivaali ja ensimmäistä kertaa järjestettävä Saimaa Folk -musiikkitapahtuma kutsuvat seuraamaan saaristokaupungin elämänrytmiä kulttuurin unelmavuoden hengessä. Savonlinnalle ominaiseen tapaan päivään mahtuvat vesillä liikkuminen, saunominen, uiminen, taide ja musiikki.

Riihisaaressa järjestettävä Savonlinnan Saunafestivaali kokoaa jo kolmatta kertaa yhteen saunojat, saunakulttuurin ystävät ja kesästä nauttijat. Kansallismaisemassa, Olavinlinnan kupeessa, lämpenee teltta-, laiva-, ja kärrysaunoja. Löylyjen välissä voi pulahtaa virkistävään Saimaaseen. Perinteinen Savonlinnan ympäriuinti starttaa Tallisaaresta lauantaina klo 13 ja päättyy Riihisaareen Saunafestivaalin tunnelmiin. Uintitapahtumasta vastaa Olavin Retkeilijät Swim Club.

Saunafestivaalin aikana Riihisaaren museo on avoinna poikkeuksellisesti klo 20 asti. Alueelta pääsee myös museohöyrylaiva S/S Mikon risteilyille Pihlajaveden saaristoon klo 14 ja 17. Risteilyllä kuullaan myös esimakua illan Saimaa Folk -tapahtumasta, kun Kuolema-duo esittää kansakoululauluja ja vanhoja virsiä harmoonin säestyksellä.

title: Pony Island 2 Panda Circus: gallop out of hell in this phantasmagorical follow-up to 2016’s indie hit
content:
Daniel Mullins explains how he plans to follow up his quirky classic without losing what made it stand out in the first place

Glitchy aesthetics. Literally collapsing menu boxes. The game taunting you by “possessing” your Steam friends. Technical tricks of this nature may sound gimmicky in 2026, but they felt excitingly unorthodox a decade ago, when Pony Island came out to critical acclaim.

Fans of Daniel Mullins, the celebrated indie developer of Inscryption, will be forgiven for forgetting that Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is in active development. After all, it’s been almost three years since the announcement – and a full decade since it was first teased as an Easter egg in Pony Island’s ARG (Alternate Reality Game) – with only a single trailer and a bunch of tunes from the soundtrack released to the public.

title: Nurmeksen Vanhan kauppalan 150-vuotisjuhlavuosi tuo alueen historian näkyväksi kaduilla ja kännykän näytöllä
content:
Historiaa rantaraitilla ja kauppalan liikkeissä

Rantaraitin varrella sijaitsevat, alun perin Veturinkuljettajan polku -hankkeessa vuonna 2015 tuotetut historiakyltit on päivitetty ja uusittu tänä kesänä. Kyltit kertovat kauppalan liikenteen ja elinkeinojen kehityksestä, varhaisen kaupunkisuunnittelun merkityksestä sekä asukkaiden vilkkaasta vapaa-ajan toiminnasta.

Lisäksi kauppalan liikkeisiin on painatettu valokuvatauluja, jotka esittävät historiallisia kuva-aiheita. Näin ohikulkija voi nähdä, millaisia rakennuksia tontilla on aikoinaan sijainnut.

Uusi Actlator-sovellus esittelee kauppalan historiaa ja kerää muistoja

Tulevana lauantaina julkaistaan Samu Aarnion suunnittelema Actlator-sovellus. Sovelluksen avulla käyttäjät voivat syventyä Vanhan kauppalan rakennuksiin ja tarinoihin digitaalisesti. Sovellus tarjoaa myös yhteisöllisen alustan. Kaupunkilaiset ja matkailijat voivat jakaa sen kautta omia muistojaan ja tarinoitaan alueen rakennuksista.

title: Piritta Rantanen: Sikarutossa on paljon pelissä – nyt tarvitaan selkeät ohjeet
content:
Suomella on sikaruton torjunnassa paljon pelissä, kansanedustaja Piritta Rantanen (sd.) sanoo.

– Jos tauti pääsisi leviämään laajasti, seuraukset näkyisivät nopeasti sikatiloilla, elintarviketeollisuudessa, kuljetuksissa, metsätaloudessa ja monien ihmisten työssä. Siksi jokainen onnistunut torjuntatoimi on samalla investointi suomalaisiin työpaikkoihin, maaseudun elinvoimaan ja huoltovarmuuteen, maa- ja metsätalousvaliokunnan jäsen Rantanen toteaa tiedotteessa.

Hän muistuttaa, että taudin leviämisen estäminen onnistuu vain, jos ihmisillä on käytössään oikeaa ja ajantasaista tietoa sekä selkeät toimintaohjeet.

– Tässä tilanteessa tärkeintä ei ole se, kuinka monta tapausta löytyy, vaan se, että kaikki tapaukset löydetään. Jokainen havainto auttaa viranomaisia muodostamaan oikean tilannekuvan ja kohdentamaan torjuntatoimet oikein. Pahin vaihtoehto olisi, että havaintoja jäisi ilmoittamatta epävarmuuden tai pelon vuoksi.

RANTASEN mukaan viranomaisten, metsästäjien, maanomistajien, maa- ja metsätalouden toimijoiden sekä kaikkien luonnossa liikkujien yhteistyö on nyt ratkaisevan tärkeää.

Pahin vaihtoehto olisi, että havaintoja jäisi ilmoittamatta epävarmuuden tai pelon vuoksi.

title: Liberté, Équité, Fiabilité – Die Wikimania zu Gast in Paris
content:
Unter dem Motto „Liberté, Équité, Fiabilité“ (Freiheit, Gleichheit, Verlässlichkeit) kamen 1.250 Menschen aus der Wikimedia Bewegung in der französischen Hauptstadt zusammen. Weitere 2.000 Teilnehmende waren online dabei. Fünf Tage lang ging es um die Frage: Wie können wir gemeinsam den freien Zugang zu Wissen stärken – und dabei soviel Spaß wie möglich haben?

Wenn es nach Audrey Tang, der ehemaligen taiwanesischen Digitalministerin und Entwicklerin für freie Software geht, lautet die Antwort ganz klar: Nein! „Don’t let it be a race. Wikipedia never tried to win.“ Es geht nicht ums Gewinnen, sondern um Teilhabe an verlässlichem Wissen für alle.

Unterdessen plädierte Jan-David Franke von Wikimedia Deutschland in seinem Lightning-Talk dafür, Wikipedia als „öffentlichen digitalen Luxus“ zu sehen. Seine Argumentation inspiriert dazu, die Wikimedia-Projekte als Gegenentwurf zu den digitalen Produkten und KI-Anwendungen der großen Tech-Konzerne zu begreifen. Ein Gegenentwurf, der den Weg zu einem menschenfreundlichen und offenen Internet für alle aufzeigt.

title: This Month at WMGH (July 2026): Localization, Wiki Loves Places Photo Walk & Wikimania 2026
content:
July for Wikimedia Ghana User Group was a month of collaboration, learning, and community participation. We localized Wikimedia features for Ghanaian language Wikipedias, took our Wiki Loves Places 2026 campaign to the streets through a photo walk, and connected with the global Wikimedia movement during Wikimania 2026.

Here’s what we’ve been up to!

On 11 July 2026, we hosted a localization workshop to translate interface messages of the Suggestion Mode feature under Edit Check for the Ghanaian Pidgin Wikipedia through Translatewiki.net.

Both new and experienced contributors learned how to translate on translatewiki and explored best practices for producing high-quality translations.

By the end of the workshop, all 110 messages for the Suggestion Mode feature had been translated into Ghanaian Pidgin. We look forward to localizing more of Wikimedia’s widely used features to make them more accessible for contributors.

Read more on Diff: Localization of Wikimedia Features: Translating Suggestion Mode for Ghanaian Language Wikipedias

title: DigiOne käyttöön Turun kouluissa – pilottikouluna Paattinen
content:
Paattisten koulu siirtyy elokuussa käyttämään DigiOnea, joka on uusi oppimisen ja koulutuksen digitaalinen alusta. Wilman korvaava DigiOne otetaan alkavan lukuvuoden aikana käyttöön myös kaikissa muissa Turun perusopetuksen kouluissa.

Paattisten koulussa alkaa syyslukukauden alkaessa uusi vaihe koulun ja kodin välisessä asioinnissa, kun Wilman tilalle otetaan käyttöön DigiOne. Paattisten koulun kokemusten pohjalta käyttöönottoa laajennetaan alkavan lukuvuoden aikana myös muihin Turun perusopetuksen kouluihin.

– Muutos näkyy niin huoltajilla, oppilailla kuin henkilökunnallakin. Kaikki käyttävät jatkossa DigiOnea kodin ja koulun väliseen asiointiin, kertoo Turun hankepäällikkö Seppo Pukonen.

DigiOnessa huoltajat voivat lukea koulun viestejä ja tiedotteita, seurata lukujärjestystä ja kotitehtäviä, selvittää poissaoloja, tarkastella arviointeja ja koetuloksia sekä nähdä oman lapsen perustietoja ja todistuksia. Lisäksi palvelussa voidaan hoitaa esimerkiksi loma-anomuksia ja koulukuljetushakemuksia.

Tavoitteena on, että arjen asiointi säilyy sujuvana myös järjestelmän vaihtuessa.

title: ‘I have an ego that needs to be put in check’: ex-Gawker editor AJ Daulerio on life after addiction
content:
After his fall from grace, media’s former enfant terrible is now sober and helping others with his addiction recovery newsletter and podcast, The Small Bow

Every other Tuesday, AJ Daulerio wakes up at 5.30am and meditates for five to 20 minutes before beginning his multistep daily journaling protocol: reading a selection from a poetry anthology, then a passage from one of his daily wisdom readers (his go-to is a heavily annotated copy of Leo Tolstoy’s A Calendar of Wisdom); writing his Fear of the Day and gratitude list, then sharing his spiritual takeaway in a note to his three kids.

After a banana and coffee, Daulerio trains Brazilian jujitsu before hitting a 9.45am meditation at Besant Lodge – a community center just below the Hollywood sign that once served as a meeting place for mid-century mystics – immediately followed by him leading a recovery meeting of his own through Zoom.

title: arXiv welcomes inaugural CEO and founding Board of Directors
content: "We have exciting news to share today: the appointment of Dr. Penelope Lewis as arXiv’s inaugural Chief Executive Officer and the establishment of our Board of Directors. If you’ve been following arXiv’s transition to an independent nonprofit organization, these leadership appointments mark a significant step in our journey. Having a CEO and Board in place strengthens our governance, sustainability, and capacity to serve the global research community for generations to come. For more than three decades, arXiv has enabled rapid and open sharing of scientific research. It has operated largely on the support and dedication of its staff, moderators, volunteers, members, funders, and, for the past 25 years, the institutional backing of Cornell. As the scale, reach, and importance of the platform have grown, so too has the need for more formal leadership and governance structures that support long-term sustainability. title: EuroWeb: From Ancient Threads to Digital Platforms
content:
Every piece of fabric has a story to tell. The colours, patterns and weaves of each piece reveal centuries of craft, trade and cultural exchange. Some of these stories are hidden in the mineralised textiles of Pompeii, while others lie in the ancient silk routes that once connected Asia and Europe, or in the wool and dyes that clothed everyone from kings to ordinary people.

The COST Action Europe Through Textiles: Network for an integrated and interdisciplinary Humanities (EuroWeb) connected people studying these stories. From archaeologists and conservators to fashion historians and textile artists, EuroWeb created a network where knowledge could travel as freely as fabrics once did.

title: HELSUS and RESET are planning a series of Horizon Europe matchmaking sessions for 2027 calls

Several of the calls explicitly require interdisciplinary approaches and, in some cases, the effective contribution of SSH disciplines.

title: Ett nordiskt nätverk bygger på förtroende
content:
Ett nordiskt nätverk uppstår inte bara genom att man bjuder in organisationer från olika länder att delta i samma projekt. Ett fungerande partnerskap byggs upp gradvis, genom ett gemensamt behov, genom att hitta rätt samarbetspartner och skapa den typ av förtroende som gör att utbytet av erfarenheter blir verkligt givande.

Johanna Granhage har varit delaktig i uppbyggnaden av ett nordiskt nätverk som samlar organisationer som arbetar med psykisk hälsa och krisstöd i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Syftet med nätverket är att skapa en plattform där organisationer som bedriver liknande verksamhet kan lära av varandra, dela praktiska erfarenheter och bygga personliga kontakter över nationsgränserna.

Idén till nätverket växte fram ur en mycket praktisk situation. Mind höll på att förnya sitt telefon- och chatt-system, och som en del av den processen började organisationen undersöka vilka typer av lösningar andra organisationer med liknande verksamhet använde sig av. Detta ledde till kontakt med den norska organisationen för psykisk hälsa Kirkens SOS. De första samtalen visade snabbt att organisationerna hade mycket gemensamt.

title: A Nordic network is built on trust
content:
Demos funding enables Nordic encounters where shared challenges can grow into long lasting cooperation. Johanna Granhage from the Swedish mental health organization Mind explains how a network of organizations working with mental health and crisis support has been built on a shared need, trust and a willingness to learn from one another across borders. 

A Nordic network does not emerge simply by inviting organisations from different countries to join the same project. A functioning partnership is built gradually, through a shared need, finding the right partners and creating the kind of trust that makes sharing experiences genuinely useful. 

Johanna Granhage from the Swedish organisation Mind has been involved in building a Nordic network that brings together organisations working with mental health and crisis support in Sweden, Norway and Finland. The aim of the network is to create a platform where organisations doing similar work can learn from one another, share practical experiences and build personal connections across national borders.

title: Pohjoismainen verkosto rakentuu luottamuksesta
content:
Demos-tuki mahdollistaa pohjoismaisia kohtaamisia, joissa yhteisistä haasteista voi kasvaa pysyvämpää yhteistyötä. Ruotsalaisen mielenterveysjärjestö Mindin Johanna Granhage kertoo, miten mielenterveys- ja kriisityötä tekevien järjestöjen verkosto on rakentunut yhteisestä tarpeesta, luottamuksesta ja halusta oppia toisilta yli maarajojen. 

Pohjoismainen verkosto ei synny vain siitä, että organisaatioita eri maista kutsutaan mukaan samaan hankkeeseen. Toimiva kumppanuus rakentuu vähitellen yhteisestä tarpeesta, oikeiden kumppaneiden löytämisestä ja luottamuksesta, joka tekee kokemusten jakamisesta aidosti hyödyllistä. 

Ruotsalaisen mielenterveysjärjestö Mindin Johanna Granhage on ollut mukana rakentamassa pohjoismaista verkostoa, joka kokoaa yhteen mielenterveys- ja kriisityötä tekeviä järjestöjä Ruotsista, Norjasta ja Suomesta. Verkoston tavoitteena on luoda alusta, jossa samankaltaista työtä tekevät järjestöt voivat oppia toisiltaan, jakaa käytännön kokemuksia ja rakentaa henkilökohtaisia yhteyksiä yli maarajojen.

title: Was “Charlotte Temple” America’s First Bestselling Novel?
content:
—This is a guest post by Rebecca Rose, a reference specialist in Duplication Services. It also appears in the July/August issue of the Library of Congress Magazine.

Before bestseller lists and BookTok, there was “Charlotte Temple,” an 18th-century novel that created one of America’s first and most lasting literary fandoms. Generations of readers devoured the tragic story of Charlotte, a young English girl seduced and abandoned by a British soldier during the American Revolution.

The Library’s Rare Book and Special Collections Division holds at least a dozen copies of “Charlotte Temple,” including an 1802 edition in which a later reader inserted newspaper clippings describing how, by the end of the 19th century, the New York City grave of a real-life woman named Charlotte Temple became a pilgrimage site for readers who mistook her for the fictional Charlotte.
